annotations.text:
Assumptions worth challenging:
- Dark only (Q9). No light theme drawn.
- Bottom nav = Home / Trips / Gauges / Settings. Component screens still open from their tiles.
- Values are synthetic-drive numbers, not real truck data.
Same Home screen with the adapter gone. Shows Stale, Unavailable and a faulted component side by side - the states that are easy to skip and expensive to retrofit.
The design system ADR-0001 says is our work rather than the framework's. Archivo and IBM Plex Mono are both OFL, so they can ship embedded in the WPF app.
